summary.one_line: The publication cache guard and README align with the generated site; the scoped article review remains PASS with eight draft advisories.

purpose.evidence: Read all 22 Markdown paths and both final army-placement articles. Nine RU/EN page pairs retain clear purposes. The placement pair now answers why the four elemental stacks receive their shown cells by connecting measured grid inputs, row calculation, role/strength ordering, occupancy attempts and recorded outcomes. It expressly limits this causal demonstration to the investigated Universe general pass. All 18 site pages remain draft and broader game mechanics are not certified.

structure.evidence: Checked all 18 frontmatter records against CONTRIBUTING: two landing, four meta, six explanation, four how-to and two reference pages with paired RU/EN status/type. The revised placement article places 2D diagrams beside each causal step, includes executable code after the worked example, then separates the second field, large-footprint illustration and methods/limits. Historical camera coordination is removed from article prose while NOTICE records provenance.

specificity.evidence: The traced elementals case has recorded depth 2, defensive/spread off, one shooter, 16x12 grid and seven native defender attempts. Its mask gives approach lengths 6,1,10,10,10,7,4,10,10,10; native tie-sort yields melee rows 8,4,10,3,5,9,6,1,7,2. Reconstructed scores are Earth 2034, Water 1269, Fire 940, Air 733 and attempted cells match the native trace. The older pack_12 field has saved final coordinates but no recorded mode flags; its four matching calculated cells require explicit assumed_context and do not establish the game's selected branch.

reproducibility.evidence: The downloadable walkthrough still reports elementals_trace context_source=recorded with four matching cells and seven matching native attempts, and pack_12 context_source=assumed with four conditional cell matches. `python scripts/render-placement.py --check` passed in the previous exact review; the article content is unchanged. For this publication-hardening diff, parent reports configured 8 Node, 21 Python and 19 HTML checks passing after a fresh build. In generated site output I inspected, placement_walkthrough.py is present and no .pyc/__pycache__ files appear. This review does not certify all game modes or reproduce the unpublished map.

evidence.evidence: Previous authorized raw trace/grid/source comparison remains applicable because neither article nor prepared observations changed in this diff. The recorded elemental pass has seven native defender attempts and four final cells; the older pack_12 comparison is conditional on assumed mode flags. Current README explains that Python bytecode/cache is excluded and checked while the downloadable .py remains; generated site inspection confirmed that state. I did not rerun the game or verify all binary branches.

applicability.evidence: The reconstruction enforces four size-1 elementals, 16x12 field, depth2 and no defensive/spread mode. It uses recorded mode flags when present, otherwise only an explicit assumed_context, and reports which source was used. The articles show a full causal chain for elementals_trace and identify pack_12 as a conditional comparison, not proof that the game chose the same branch. Other formations, fallback behavior and unpublished-map reproduction remain outside scope.

translations.evidence: All nine reciprocal RU/EN page pairs retain matching content_type/status/faction. New placement edits agree on local A1/N1-N4 elemental legend, recorded versus assumed mode source, pack_12's conditional comparison and the limitation that final-cell agreement does not prove branch selection. README gives the same distinction in English and Russian; full 11 browser tests passed per parent.

maintenance.evidence: README now documents publication treatment for the downloadable Python reconstruction. mkdocs.yml excludes __pycache__ and .pyc paths; check_site.py rejects bytecode/cache if found in generated output. Parent reports this check first caught a real copied cache file and then passed after exclusion/rebuild. No article, diagrams, or canonical observations changed; all 22 cumulative Markdown paths remain covered and eight existing draft advisories remain.
